description.value: Pasta Lupino is an Italian-inspired restaurant and deli in Whistler Village, open since May 2000 and run by husband-and-wife team Kevin Holland and Kendra Mazzei. The kitchen turns out freshly-made pastas, sauces, and breads for both dine-in and takeout, and the attached deli sells fresh pasta, housemade sauces, and specialty Italian groceries to take home. Its casual, cozy dining room and simple, hearty food make it a reliable refuelling stop after a day on the trails or roads.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record for name, location, and category. The site explicitly confirms dine-in, takeout, and grocery options, and lists vegetarian menu items (Veggie Lasagna, Garden Mista Salad). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website text or OSM tags; those fields are left null per instructions. The website supplies a phone number and unit number absent from OSM, so both are updated and flagged.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides 1 (604) 905-0400 — added to listing.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service restaurant and deli in Whistler Village offering dine-in, takeout, and fresh grocery provisions — a clear fit for touring cyclists seeking a meal or supplies.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated Veggie Lasagna (roasted garlic, zucchini, eggplant, peppers, spinach, ricotta) and a Garden Mista Salad; roasted veggies available as a pasta add-on. No vegan or GF options explicitly mentioned
